nodes.label: Capability gated preview
nodes.rationale: Milestone 3 deliberately exposes only draw and discard and advertises omitted features through rulesetVersion and capabilities.

nodes.label: Owner selected mahjong tile artwork
nodes.rationale: Preserve supplied artwork and recognizable tile identities unless the owner requests a change.

nodes.label: Reference faithful raster production
nodes.rationale: Clean approved assets while preserving material and composition; CSS supplies presentation chrome.

nodes.label: Shipped design system
nodes.rationale: Document evidenced tokens from the shipped code so the rulebook describes reality.

nodes.label: Entry atomicity
nodes.rationale: Apply every operation in an entry or undo its partial edits while continuing other entries.

nodes.label: Reusable Pattern Extraction
nodes.rationale: Extract patterns used three or more times with the same intent to avoid premature abstraction.

nodes.label: Operate Mode
nodes.rationale: Predictable controls and restrained styling let users focus on their task.

nodes.label: Earned Delight
nodes.rationale: Product character belongs in useful interactions without delaying the task.

nodes.label: Design Simplification
nodes.rationale: Remove obstacles while preserving necessary functionality and accessibility.

nodes.label: Artifact Drift Repair
nodes.rationale: Mechanical schema drift is repairable; truth drift requires checking documentation against current code.

nodes.label: Design System Documentation
nodes.rationale: Normative design tokens and supporting prose preserve the current visual system across new screens.

nodes.label: Interface Hardening
nodes.rationale: Production interfaces must survive extreme content, errors, languages, and network conditions.

nodes.label: Design Detector Hook
nodes.rationale: Immediate checks handle mechanical defects; Stop checks defer subjective findings and deduplicate them.

nodes.label: Product Initialization
nodes.rationale: Durable product truth is captured separately from visual identity decisions.

nodes.label: iOS Platform Guidance
nodes.rationale: Native structure and interaction follow platform conventions while brand expression uses permitted layers.

nodes.label: Layout Assessment
nodes.rationale: Reading order, grouping, rhythm, and density should express product priorities.

nodes.label: Live Variant Editing
nodes.rationale: Selected browser elements receive preview variants through the local development server.

nodes.label: Live Mode Setup
nodes.rationale: Live helper allowances remain development-only and injection avoids third-party files.

nodes.label: New Visual Work
nodes.rationale: Product truth, durable visual decisions, and surface-specific strategy have distinct authorities.

nodes.label: Product Onboarding
nodes.rationale: Onboarding should reach the first useful outcome rather than teach the entire product.

nodes.label: Interface Polish
nodes.rationale: Refinement preserves the existing system and resolves functional defects before cosmetics.

nodes.label: Visual Intensity Reduction
nodes.rationale: Reduce overstimulation while retaining personality and clear functional affordances.

nodes.label: Context Aware Command Routing
nodes.rationale: Current setup, critique, source changes, and server status guide the most relevant commands.

nodes.label: Context appropriate responsive design
nodes.rationale: Adaptation rethinks the experience for input methods and usage context rather than scaling pixels.

nodes.label: Platform size classes
nodes.rationale: Size classes restructure navigation and layout for tablets, split views and foldables.

nodes.label: Material Design 3
nodes.rationale: Material governs native structure and interaction while brand expresses through theming.

nodes.label: Motion thesis
nodes.rationale: Motion explains feedback, continuity and a focal moment under a performance budget.

nodes.label: Bao liability
nodes.rationale: One active feeder per beneficiary; replacement redirects baseline payments without stacking reason tags.

nodes.label: GameRoom Durable Object
nodes.rationale: One room authority and transaction boundary coordinates persistence, authentication, projections, and controllers.

nodes.label: PlayerObservation
nodes.rationale: Seat specific observations prevent controllers from seeing another hand, pending claim, or wall order.

nodes.label: Pure CPython Mahjong engine
nodes.rationale: Keep game transitions independent of Workers, HTTP, SQLite, authentication, wall clock, and connections.

nodes.label: StrategicBotPolicy
nodes.rationale: Planned policy prioritizes Game Kong Pong Chow, then minimizes shanten and maximizes theoretical ukeire using only permitted observations.

nodes.label: Opaque action catalogs
nodes.rationale: Clients submit server issued action IDs instead of authoritative tile or rule decisions.

nodes.label: Three second claim windows
nodes.rationale: Persist deadlines and resolve at deadline independently of claim arrival order.

nodes.label: Audit Health Score
nodes.rationale: Measurable accessibility, performance, theming, responsiveness and implementation integrity are scored separately.

nodes.label: Platform Conformance Verdict
nodes.rationale: Source audits score native accessibility, performance, appearance, conformance and adaptivity.

nodes.label: Rendered quality checks
nodes.rationale: Verify actual contrast, spacing, typography, motion and interface states in batched inspections.

nodes.label: Evidence and fidelity gate
nodes.rationale: Missing or malformed captures force recapture before any fidelity verdict.

nodes.label: Copyright and patent grants
nodes.rationale: Grants permissions subject to redistribution and attribution conditions.

nodes.label: Subject grounded visual identity
nodes.rationale: Industry, audience, materials and vernacular determine distinctive visual choices.

nodes.label: Message hierarchy
nodes.rationale: State the needed fact, next action and consequential context while preserving product meaning.

nodes.label: Scoped amplification
nodes.rationale: Raise the named target to the existing visual system without restyling unrelated surfaces.

nodes.label: Semantic color roles
nodes.rationale: Use color to encode hierarchy, action, status and atmosphere while preserving brand commitments.

nodes.label: Ordinary visual work routing
nodes.rationale: The alias adds no checkpoints; use normal setup and new-work routing.

nodes.label: Independent assessments
nodes.rationale: Separate design judgment from detector evidence to avoid anchoring the synthesis.

nodes.label: Frontend design workflow
nodes.rationale: Combines production code, creative direction, user needs and bounded verification.

nodes.label: Interface Performance Optimization
nodes.rationale: Measure before and after to fix actual bottlenecks instead of guessing.

nodes.label: Technical Interface Enhancement
nodes.rationale: Ambitious browser effects must preserve a functional fallback and suit the product context.

nodes.label: Canonical room_state snapshot
nodes.rationale: Eviction recovery reconstructs exclusively from SQLite snapshot rather than replaying hidden events.

nodes.label: Non authoritative Supabase
nodes.rationale: Retained scaffold is unused by domain and persistence foundation.

nodes.label: SQLite room_state snapshot
nodes.rationale: Sole reconstruction source; audit events and operational credentials are not replayed to reconstruct state.
